This early, the East River takes on a thin layer of translucence...
Isabel and Dan's apartment was almost half finished...
Dan stands at the kitchen counter...
Isabel envisions herself sitting here on the stairs for years to come.
Nathan and Violet's room is still the nursery Isabel exactingly constructed...
Isabel is doing her eyes when Robbie walks into the bathroom.
Violet and Nathan sit at the kitchen table...
A woman weeping on the subway is always a stranger.
After Dan and Nathan have been seen to the front door...
The sidewalk in front of the school is crowded with children and parents.
Robbie holds Odin on the sofa with Violet pushed up close...
Isabel should be in the office.
Dan, back at home, sits on the sofa, playing his new song for Robbie.
Although Robbie isn't packing up yet, he's begun sorting through the small stuff...
The park is still wintry, its grass sere and its trees bare.
Adam was the third, between Peter and Oliver.
Derrick scowls over the photographs laid out on the far end of the table
As Dan and Garth walk along the path in the park, Garth bounces the baby...
Derrick isn't pleased by the photos of Astoria...
The white Chihuahua is absent from the dog run.
Robbie picks up the next essay.
Robbie stands at the threshold of the cabin, with the door propped open.
There's a song inside the song.
Violet doesn't knock, and there's no lock on the door.
For Chess, time has become so innocent...
Isabel should go to the children...
Violet sits expectantly on her bed, on the edge of the mattress, her feet planted on the floor.
The choir has progressed from its initial murmuring to one of the most fervent interludes, twenty minutes in.
Isabel, out on the stairs, has received a text from Dan...
Garth had never intended to be a man standing on a sidewalk waving with slightly desperate vigor...
After Garth has performed his wave-and-dance routine and moved on...
Back in the bedroom...where else is there for him to go...
Isabel descends the stairs and walks outside.
Darkness comes early to the house in the woods.
In the living room, Chess sits with Odin on the exhausted old rose-pink armchair...
Dan extinguishes the ignition and turns off the headlights.
The cabin on the mountain in Iceland is empty until the next renters...
Chess finds Garth smoking a cigarette on the back stoop...
There is the question of dinner.
No one suspects that Nathan has slipped away and gone to the lake.
When Violet announces that she's going upstairs with her suitcase...
Garth hadn't expected Isabel's "house in the country" to be moldy and dank...
Once Nathan has gone into the water...
Isabel finds Chess sitting in the damaged chair behind the house.
Garth's headlights illuminate nothing but the road and the trees until they shine, abruptly, onto Nathan.
Chess lies on the sofa with Odin on her chest...
Dan stands on the front porch...
On the road in the woods, Garth puts the car into gear and drives, looking for a place to turn around.
Violet waits at the window until Robbie's shadow has passed.
Isabel passes quietly through the living room...
